observations: Two photos show multiple used automotive parts, primarily black metal components with mounting brackets and bolts, likely engine or transmission mounts.
Parts are arranged on wooden shelves in a cluttered, dimly lit workshop or storage area.
Photo 0 shows three similar parts in a row; one central part has a visible bolt and flange, with a watermark 'MASTER JD KIA HYUNDAI'.
Photo 1 shows a closer view of two similar parts, one with a circular top and a hex bolt, the other with a flanged base and mounting tabs; same watermark present.
No visible brand or model markings on the parts themselves.
Watermark 'MASTER JD KIA HYUNDAI' appears in both photos, suggesting the seller specializes in Kia and Hyundai parts.
No clear evidence of engine, gearbox, or underbody parts as claimed in the text — only mounts or brackets are visible.

claims.claim: We sale all kinds of Kia Hyundai engine, gear box, engine parts and underneath
claims.evidence: Photos show only engine or transmission mounts, not full engines, gearboxes, or underbody parts. The watermark suggests specialization in Kia/Hyundai, but no parts are labeled or identifiable as such.

risks.risk: Parts may be from non-Kia/Hyundai vehicles or incompatible with the buyer's vehicle.
risks.proof: Clear photo of part with visible VIN or part number, or a photo showing the part installed on a specific vehicle model.
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic used mounts, not Kia/Hyundai specific

risks.risk: Parts may be damaged or worn beyond acceptable use (e.g., cracked rubber, rusted metal, broken bolts).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of each part showing condition of rubber bushings, metal surfaces, and mounting points.
risks.if_unproven: priced as worn or possibly defective

risks.risk: Seller may be misrepresenting the type of parts (e.g., calling mounts 'engine parts' to mislead).
risks.proof: Photo showing the part installed on a vehicle or a clear label identifying the part type and application.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photos of each part showing part numbers, VIN tags, or any identifying marks.
Photos of the parts installed on a vehicle or with a label indicating make, model, and application.
Photo showing the full range of parts advertised (engine, gearbox, underbody) to verify the claim.
response.reason: The photos show only engine or transmission mounts, not the full engines, gearboxes, or underbody parts claimed. The watermark suggests Kia/Hyundai specialization, but no model or brand is visible on the parts. Without proof of part identity and condition, the item cannot be priced accurately.
